FILE.LABEL: TickTick backup file (.csv)
FILE.INTRO: Brings your open TickTick tasks, sub-tasks, checklists, tags and due dates into Super Productivity. The import only adds data — nothing in Super Productivity is changed or removed.
FILE.HELP: Create the backup in the TickTick web app under Settings → Backup → Generate backup. The file is read on this device only; nothing is uploaded.
FILE.REQUIRED: Please choose your TickTick backup file first.
FILE.NOT_TICKTICK: This does not look like a TickTick backup — choose the .csv file from Settings → Backup. If TickTick is set to a language other than English, try switching it to English and generating the backup again.
FILE.NO_PROJECTS: No open tasks found in this backup.

ERROR.IMPORT_STOPPED: Import stopped at “{{project}}”: {{error}}. That project was created only partially — delete “{{project}}” before re-running, then select it and the remaining projects again.

PREVIEW.LOSS_HEADING: What will not survive the move
PREVIEW.SELECT_PROJECT: Select at least one list to import.

LOSS.FOLDERS: Folders flattened into the project list: {{count}}.
LOSS.COLUMNS: Kanban columns dropped (tasks keep their order in the project): {{count}}.
LOSS.DEMOTED_SUBTASKS: Deeply nested sub-tasks made direct sub-tasks (2 levels max): {{count}}.
LOSS.RECURRING: Recurring tasks keeping only their next date (the rule is noted in task notes): {{count}}.
LOSS.SUBTASK_TAGS: Sub-task tags not imported (sub-tasks have no tags): {{count}}.
LOSS.SUBTASK_PRIORITIES: Prioritized sub-tasks not receiving priority tags: {{count}}.
LOSS.TRUNCATED_FIELDS: Unusually long values shortened to safe import limits: {{count}}.
LOSS.CLOSED_TASKS: Completed, archived and won't-do tasks in the backup skipped: {{count}}.
LOSS.NOT_IN_BACKUP: Attachments, comments, focus records and habits are not part of the TickTick backup.

SUMMARY.SHORTFALL: some items did not land; please review
SUMMARY.UNVERIFIED: Could not verify the imported counts — the numbers above may show 0 even for tasks that landed.
SUMMARY.UNDO: The import is additive — to undo it, delete the created projects.
